title: Is Vibe Coding Safe? The Lovable Security Breach and What Founders Must Know
summary: A BOLA flaw exposed Lovable users' source code for 48 days. Here's what vibe coding security risks mean for founders and what structural safety looks like.
body_markdown: Blink manages authentication, database access, and storage at the platform level — these components are not regenerated for each project. Your app logic runs on top of Blink's infrastructure, so the authorization layer is consistent and platform-maintained rather than AI-generated from scratch each time. This structural approach reduces the categories of vulnerability that emerge when a model writes every security-critical layer from a blank state.
